## ROBOTICS IN MOTION

### Three paths. One mission.

**Created October 17, 2026**  
An interactive Plotly presentation about simulated drone navigation.

The routes are illustrative simulations, not observations of real drone flights.

## THE MISSION

A drone travels from launch `(0, 0, 1.2)` to destination `(10, 0, 1.2)`.

- **Direct:** shortest route, but crosses the restricted obstacle.
- **Ground detour:** swings laterally around the obstacle.
- **Vertical bypass:** climbs above the obstacle and descends.

The obstacle is modeled as a cylinder centered at `(5, 0)` with radius **1.15 km** and height **2.8 km**. All coordinates are illustrative kilometers.

## EXPLORE THE FLIGHT PATHS

Drag to rotate the 3D scene, scroll to zoom, and hover over any route.

```{r plotly-3d, fig.height=5.0, fig.width=10}
t <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 151)
paths <- list(
  "Direct" = data.frame(x = 10*t, y = 0*t, z = 0*t + 1.2),
  "Ground detour" = data.frame(x = 10*t, y = 2.1*sin(pi*t), z = 0*t + 1.2),
  "Vertical bypass" = data.frame(x = 10*t, y = 0*t, z = 1.2 + 2.9*sin(pi*t))
)
colors <- c("Direct"="#fb7185", "Ground detour"="#2dd4bf", "Vertical bypass"="#c4b5fd")
angle <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 80)
obstacle_x <- rbind(5 + 1.15*cos(angle), 5 + 1.15*cos(angle))
obstacle_y <- rbind(1.15*sin(angle), 1.15*sin(angle))
obstacle_z <- rbind(rep(0, 80), rep(2.8, 80))
p <- plot_ly()
p <- add_surface(p, x=obstacle_x, y=obstacle_y, z=obstacle_z,
                 opacity=0.42, showscale=FALSE, name="Restricted zone",
                 colorscale=list(c(0,"#fb7185"), c(1,"#fb7185")),
                 hoverinfo="skip", showlegend=FALSE)
for (n in names(paths)) {
  d <- paths[[n]]
  p <- add_trace(p, x=d$x, y=d$y, z=d$z, type="scatter3d", mode="lines",
                 name=n, line=list(color=colors[[n]], width=8),
                 hovertemplate=paste0("<b>", n, "</b><br>X: %{x:.2f} km<br>Y: %{y:.2f} km<br>Z: %{z:.2f} km<extra></extra>"))
}
p <- add_trace(p, x=c(0,10), y=c(0,0), z=c(1.2,1.2), type="scatter3d",
               mode="markers+text", text=c("Launch","Destination"),
               textposition="top center", marker=list(size=6,color=c("#ffffff","#fde68a")),
               name="Endpoints", showlegend=FALSE)
p <- layout(p, scene=list(
  xaxis=list(title="X: distance (km)",range=c(-0.6,10.6)),
  yaxis=list(title="Y: offset (km)",range=c(-2.2,3)),
  zaxis=list(title="Z: altitude (km)",range=c(0,5.2)),
  aspectratio=list(x=1.7,y=0.9,z=0.72)),
  margin=list(l=0,r=0,b=0,t=25),
  legend=list(orientation="h",x=0.1,y=1.07))
p
```

## HOW FAR DOES EACH ROUTE TRAVEL?

Route lengths are calculated by summing 150 small 3D straight-line segments per path.

```{r plotly-distance, fig.height=4.4, fig.width=10}
path_length <- function(d) {
  dx <- diff(d$x); dy <- diff(d$y); dz <- diff(d$z)
  sum(sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2))
}
distances <- vapply(paths, path_length, numeric(1))
plot_ly(x=unname(distances), y=names(distances), type="bar", orientation="h",
        marker=list(color=unname(colors[names(distances)])),
        text=paste0(round(distances, 2), " km"),textposition="outside",
        hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x:.2f} km<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(xaxis=list(title="Modeled route length (km)",range=c(0,14)),
         yaxis=list(title="",categoryorder="array",categoryarray=rev(names(distances))),
         margin=list(l=125,r=60,t=20,b=45))
```

The shortest distance is not always a feasible flight path: the direct route intersects the obstacle.

## WHAT DOES THE MODEL TEACH US?

- **Safety first.** A geometrically short route can be blocked.
- **Plan in three dimensions.** Lateral and vertical maneuvers offer different trade-offs.
- **Optimization needs constraints.** Real autonomous navigation also considers speed, energy, weather, regulations, and separation margins.

**This is a simplified geometry exercise, not a real-world flight-planning or safety model.**
